hypothesis: A radius-four DRP second-derivative stencil optimized analytically through 0.45 Nyquist reduces the exact high-frequency train/Marmousi error from 0.263 to no greater than 0.05 while the existing five-step CUDA graph remains below 2.034137312322855 s.
mechanism: Dispersion-relation-preserving coefficients trade unused near-zero Taylor order for lower integrated phase error over the physically occupied wavenumber band; CUDA graph replay changes only dispatch.
single_conceptual_change: standard radius-four eighth-order coefficients to radius-four DRP coefficients with max_nyquist_fraction=0.45
failure_signal: Either gate failure rejects DRP-0.45 before any broader train or holdout evaluation.
compute_budget: One high-frequency train/Marmousi record and one warmed CUDA-graph solve on one RTX 4090 D.
rollback: Keep the standard coefficients and cuda_graphs disabled by default; preserve all artifacts.
